scope: Real Ascend NPU, HTTP token-ID completions, normal dense Qwen3, DP1 per worker

model_manifest.revision: not recorded by original download; fixed by actual SHA256

workload.method: Fixed shuffled order, equal prefix placement, clear both engines and rewarm before each arm; AB/BA/AB ordering. Warmup is excluded. HTTP SSE first generated token determines TTFT; p95 uses the observed order statistic. Single hardware run; no confidence interval.

resource_audit.note: Another task used card3 after both acceptance files were complete. Initial cleanup guard was too broad; interval review preserved failures and cleanup only stopped owned services.

limitations: Synthetic fixed prefix placement and one generated token; benefits are specific to this workload, not general Agent task throughput.
Native vLLM Python HTTP engines use an acceptance-only discovery adapter; native gRPC and DP16 were not tested.
Agent hints: real generation, parsing and malformed rejection with binding_only; calibrated priority/deadline/TTL admission and physical KV retention were not measured.
Real restart, event-gap transport injection, hybrid, external KV, P/D, EPD, IGW and HA were not measured.
Original model download revision is unavailable; the actual complete files are fixed by SHA256.
Shared host with per-container CPU/RAM quotas and per-card process auditing; no whole-host CPU isolation.
